dish.note: Poached chicken set in clear jelly, sliced cold with salad and pickles.
dish.how: Simmer a 1.6kg chicken with 1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick and 2 bay leaves in 1.5 litres of water for 45 minutes, then cool in the stock for 20 minutes. Pick the meat into chunks. Strain 500ml of the stock, whisk in 4 tsp gelatine softened in cold water until dissolved, and stir in 2 tbsp chopped parsley. Pack the chicken into a lined loaf tin, pour over the stock and chill at least 3 hours. Turn out and serve sliced with lettuce, tomato and pickled onions.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with the onion, carrot, celery and bay leaves.
Cool the chicken in the stock, then pick the meat into chunks.
Strain and measure the stock, dissolve the gelatine in it and add the parsley.
Pack the chicken into a lined loaf tin and pour over the stock.
Turn out, slice and serve with salad and pickled onions.

dish.make_ahead: Make the day before; it needs at least 3 hours to set

veg.n: Country egg and herb terrine with salad (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel, then cut into chunks.
Simmer the stock with the agar for 3 minutes, then add the parsley and chives.
Blanch the peas for 2 minutes and drain.
Pack the eggs and peas into a lined loaf tin and pour over the stock.
Turn out, slice and serve with salad and pickled onions.
